name: shadcn/studio
summary: Open-source and premium shadcn components, blocks and templates with a theme generator and AI tools.
description: A distribution of copy-paste shadcn components, blocks and templates: 659 registry items, 1000+ UI blocks (marketing, dashboard, eCommerce, datatable, bento grid), 100+ pages and 25+ templates, with animated Motion variants on Base UI or Radix UI. Extra tooling includes a live theme generator, a Figma design kit with a Figma-to-code plugin, a drag-and-drop page builder and an MCP server. Open source under MIT, with a paid all-access tier.
contains: 1000+ shadcn UI blocks: marketing, dashboard & application, eCommerce, datatable, bento grid
100+ ready pages and 25+ templates (landing pages, dashboards, frontend templates)
Component variants with Motion animations, on Base UI and Radix UI
Live theme generator, Figma design kit + Figma-to-code plugin, drag-and-drop page builder, MCP server
Install via shadcn CLI or copy-paste; full code ownership
MIT-licensed open source, supported by ThemeSelection
